**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is planning a trip to Zion National Park in Utah.  
[EVENT] User is looking for hiking trail recommendations for their trip.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Zion National Park is a hiker's paradise and offers several popular and challenging trails.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular trails include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Angel's Landing: A strenuous 5-mile round-trip hike with an elevation gain of 1,400 feet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. The Narrows: A scenic hike that follows the Virgin River.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Observation Point: An 8-mile round-trip hike with an elevation gain of 2,100 feet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. West Rim Trail: A moderate 10-mile round-trip hike.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Challenging trails include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. The Subway: A strenuous 9-mile round-trip hike requiring rock scrambling.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. The West Rim Trail to Angels Landing: A challenging 10-mile round-trip hike.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. The Chain Trail: A strenuous 3-mile round-trip hike involving chains and ladders.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. The East Rim Trail: A challenging 10-mile round-trip hike.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Important considerations include checking the park's website for trail information, preparing for extreme heat, and wearing sturdy hiking boots.  
[USER] User is looking for a trail that offers scenic views of the canyon and isn't too crowded.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended trail: Kayenta Trail.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Kayenta Trail details:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Distance: 2 miles round-trip  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Elevation gain: 500 feet  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Difficulty: Moderate  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Time: 2-3 hours  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Kayenta Trail offers breathtaking views of the Virgin River and is often less crowded.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The trail connects to the Emerald Pools Trail for additional exploration.  
[USER] User is planning to camp for a few nights during their trip.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended camping sites near Zion National Park include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Watchman Campground: 176 individual campsites, open year-round.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Lava Point Campground: 6 individual campsites, open from May
